"text":"Request Arlo Copperwisp's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. The existing estate binder, drafted by Buttonwood Balloon Legal in 2016, lacks trust funding evidence and may contain outdated fiduciary role information that does not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure. Ensure all documents are up to date for advisor review.",
